name: Bharari
boundary_summary: Municipal boundary near Jangal Pagog, Kelti, Green Gate and Lower Bharari School; the south side follows the nallah below Snowdon Hospital toward the tunnel by Auckland parking.

name: Ruldu Bhatta
boundary_summary: The schedule refers to Lower Bharari Road in the north, the Ridge toward Scandal Point in the south and Mall Road near the State Bank on the west.

name: Kaithu
boundary_summary: The north reaches the municipal boundary at Golchha; the nallah below P&T Colony and part of Cart Road mark the east and south.

name: Annandale
boundary_summary: The northern edge touches Karog on the municipal boundary. Mall Road and the crossing near the Indian Institute of Advanced Study frame parts of the south and west.

name: Summer Hill
boundary_summary: The north and west follow municipal limits from Glen Nallah. Mall Road and North Mall Road at the Indian Institute of Advanced Study crossing are southern and eastern references.

name: Totu
boundary_summary: Jangal Gadawag to the north, Badehri revenue village and a nallah to the south, Dogra House and Totu Road to the east, and Jutogh Cantonment to the west.

name: Majiath
boundary_summary: Gadawag revenue village to the north, Bharyal village to the south, Badehri forest to the east and a nallah to the west.

name: Boileauganj
boundary_summary: The schedule uses the Shimla–Mandi road and bypass junction as a reference and lists Mall Road and the Willy Park nallah on the east.

name: Kachi Ghatti
boundary_summary: The schedule uses the Boileauganj bypass and Chakkar junction, the municipal boundary via Sankat Mochan, and Tara Devi railway station as reference points.

name: Tuti Kandi-Badai
boundary_summary: The highway near Hari Nagar lies along the north and west; Khalini Nallah marks the south and the bypass near Phagli Nallah marks the east.

name: Nabha
boundary_summary: Mall Road near Willy Park and Kennedy House marks the north; the road via Kennedy House to Cart Road and the existing municipal boundary near Lower Nabha also appear in the schedule.

name: Phagli
boundary_summary: The railway bridge and Cart Road mark part of the north. The schedule uses the nallah below Ram Nagar on the south and the route towards Phagli Labour Hostel on the west.

name: Krishna Nagar
boundary_summary: The local bus stand and Cart Road are northern references. Combermere Nallah and Bembloi Nallah near Nirankari Bhawan and the bypass mark other sides.

name: Ram Bazar Ganj
boundary_summary: The schedule references the Deputy Commissioner's office below Lower Bazar on the north, Cart Road on the south and Bembloi Nallah toward Marina Hotel on the east.

name: Lower Bazar
boundary_summary: The north runs from the Railway Board building toward Mall Road and Scandal Point. Cart Road and the tourist information centre are western references.

name: Jakhu
boundary_summary: The northern edge references the Snowdon Pump House nallah. The south runs from Ridge Church toward municipal parking and Jodha Niwas.

name: Benmore
boundary_summary: The schedule follows Mall Road near the Sanjauli pumping station to the north and Cart Road from Sanjauli Chowk toward Chhotta Shimla on the east.

name: Engine Ghar
boundary_summary: St Bede's College and Sanjauli Chowk mark parts of the north. The east adjoins a nallah near Sukh Niwas; the south references the municipal boundary.

name: Sanjauli Chowk
boundary_summary: The schedule refers to the Indira Gandhi Medical College Chowk nallah, Dhingu Bawari nallah toward the Dhalli–Mehli highway, the area above Dhalli Tunnel, and Snowdon nallah.

name: Upper Dhalli
boundary_summary: Lambidhar lies to the north, Lower Dhalli to the south and east, and Tibetan Colony to the west.

name: Lower Dhalli
boundary_summary: Dhalli ward and Jungle Mashobra lie to the north, Badah revenue village and the catchment area to the south, Seepur to the east and Sanjauli to the west.

name: Shanti Vihar
boundary_summary: The schedule uses Dhalli Bypass Road and Chhakrayal on the north, the Dhalli–Mehli highway and Chamyana on the south, Kamlanagar on the east and Sangti on the west.

name: Bhattakufar
boundary_summary: Chhakrayal is the northern reference, Chamiyana the southern and eastern reference, and Shanti Vihar ward the western reference.

name: Sangti
boundary_summary: Sanjauli lies to the north and east, Malyana 1st to the south and Chhota Shimla to the west.

name: Malyana
boundary_summary: The schedule lists Chhota Shimla to the north, Malyana to the south, Sangti ward to the east and Mehli to the west.

name: Pantha Ghatti
boundary_summary: Mehli gram panchayat area lies to the north and east, Patti village to the south and the SDA Complex to the west.

name: Kasumpti
boundary_summary: Kasumpti Chabrogti lies to the north, Malyana ward to the south, Mehli to the east and Chotta Shimla to the west.

name: Chhotta Shimla
boundary_summary: The schedule uses the Mall Road junction, Mazitha House nallah and Sadhana Ghati on the north, and the Vikasnagar nallah, highway and Kasumpti Chowk along the southern or western approaches.

name: Vikasnagar
boundary_summary: The north starts along the road labelled NH 22 in the schedule. Central Park and Pathak Colony are southern references; Dev Nagar nallah is on the east.

name: Kangna Dhar
boundary_summary: Dhalli–Shimla Road lies to the north, Baragaon to the south, Vikas Nagar to the east and Hateshwari Mata Temple to the west.

name: Pateog
boundary_summary: BCS School lies to the north, New Shimla ward to the south, Kangna Dhar to the east and Khalini to the west.

name: New Shimla
boundary_summary: Pateog lies to the north, Rajana to the south, Kangna Dhar to the east and Khalini to the west, as described in Annexure I.

name: Khalini
boundary_summary: Knolls Wood Colony lies to the north, Bihar village to the south, BCS to the east and the nallah at the Shiva Gas Company store to the west.

name: Kanlog
boundary_summary: The schedule references Oak Over below Mall Road on the north, CPRI on the south, Green Park Estate on the east, and Ram Niwas and Nirankari Bhawan on the west.
